commitments.detail: Update the policy draft to exclude EU-regulated project artifacts from the 90-day auto-deletion rule, setting their inactivity period to 365 days per the records-classification review.
Extend the recovery window in the policy from 14 days to 45 days, matching the confirmed restore-index reliability, and update the runbook accordingly.
Add a 30-day advance notice requirement before queuing inactive artifacts for deletion for the twelve legacy enterprise plan customers.
Add a mandatory secret-scrub step before erasure in the deletion worker and extend deletion audit log retention from 30 days to 400 days with tamper-evident records.
All four constraints must be incorporated into the change ticket and the updated policy draft before final sign-off is executed.
